evidence: Returns profile options bit 5 / championship entry flags bit 0; stored in every best-time record as the bit the record lists show as "AT" (else "MT"); defaults to 1.
Writes the bit RallyData_GetDriverAutomaticGearbox reads (profile options bit 5, or championship flags bit 0 plus the edited bit).
Returns g_frameRate (1000 / the last frame time in ms); its callers print it with the fps format or pass it to StageObject_SetFrameRate.
Called every frame with Graphics_GetFrameRate() in 16.16 (25 at reset); sets g_stageObjectScale = rate / 25 and g_stageObjectTimeStep = its reciprocal.
All callers pass the car box, body axes, position and eight world corners; computes horizontal axes and extents, stores geometry pointers, sets built and builds the footprint.
Only caller is Collision_BuildCarBox; scales CollisionBox axes by half extents, writes points[0..3] and translates them by position with y fixed to box top.
Returns the indexed CollisionBox from the eight-car table at 0x590ed0; Collision_TestCarAgainstSectorEdges uses it as g_collisionFace.

Reads the six ObjectPointBounds fields stored by Collision_BuildObjectPointBounds, expands them by 512 and constructs a cached CollisionBox translated to the object position; no sprite data is accessed.
Caches the object position, SectorObjectBounds::radius and the first MeshCollisionRecord::height; called when the sector entry has no box projection, with no material access.
Projects the object sphere centre onto the car box axes, tests half extents plus radius, and calls CarPhysics_UpdateWheelSlipAndVelocityDamping; reads no rendering or lighting state.

Starts from mass/4, subtracts suspension-height and travel corrections times mass/8, and writes the eight-corner load table at 0x8b8 (first four here); the grip solver consumes these scalar loads, not wheel torque.
Returns g_carPartSetLookup[index], populated with CarPartSet records by 0x4667c0; consumers read geometry, damage and hidden states.
Reads g_carPartSets[Car::index].partHidden[slot] at +0x4b0; 0x469bf0 sets it and 0x46b670 applies it to node visibility.
Release callback frees original per-part vertex copies, node-type copies, CarPartSet and CarDamageRecord arrays, then clears the car count.
Allocates the CarPartSet/CarDamageRecord arrays and original vertex/node-type pointer tables, builds the set lookup and registers their release callback.
For a nonzero hidden flag and present node, writes zero to g_carPartNodes[slot][Car::index]->viewMask; zero flag leaves the mask unchanged.
Returns byte g_carPartModelIndices[slot][carIndex], filled alongside the node by matching model node classes in 0x480af0.
Returns g_carPartNodes[slot][Car::index]; assignment 0x480af0 stores SceneNode pointers and light setup 0x463fe0 reads node geometry.
Looks up the car part set and passes each of its four partHidden flags to the node-hiding helper 0x480ac0.
Writes one to partHidden[slot] then rebuilds derived damage values; 0x483010 calls it when deactivating a moving part.
Reads CarPartSet::partBroken[4/5]; 0x4643f0 gates both light channels with these outputs for braking, reversing, head lights and hazards; break slots 4/5 map to model node types 8/9.
Walks g_carDamageRecords in reverse, invokes the per-record damage reset, then clears the two local-player deformation cooldown arrays; no replay stream is accessed.
Resets stageImpacts link pool and stageDamage intensity/hidden/grounded fields, then copies them into active impacts/damage; preserves stageSnapshotCaptured and snapshot padding.
Zeroes sizeof(CarPartSet) records in g_carPartSets for the supplied first/count range; it does not touch the replay streams or CarDamageRecord array.
Clears active bit 0 of the current PartState flags and calls CarPart_MarkHidden with the slot in its high nibble.
Seeds rand with 400, selects g_partCar, restores each attached SceneNode::current from local, and clears its PartState::pNode in slots 3..0.
Sets both light-channel masks from car controls and part breakage, updates hazard timing, then fades/positions each CarLightPoint glow from channel levels and deformed vertices.
Returns g_carDamageModelEnabled[Car::index]; light setup/update use it to choose deformed geometry, matching other damage-enabled consumers.

Loads CIN light points, creates one GlowLight per point plus the two rear-view SceneNode lights, links type-9 points/glows to exhaust emitters, then records the closest deform mesh/vertex; no Mesh is built.
Stores the supplied integer in g_carDamageModelEnabled[carIndex], read by CarDamage_GetModelEnabled and deformation consumers.
Zeroes all eight g_carDamageModelEnabled integers on race-state reset.
Zeroes all four PartState arrays for g_carPartTableCarCount cars, clears the four-by-eight SceneNode table and initializes model indices to 0xff.
